t: No, thank you. No help needed at the moment. Perhaps, tonight we’ll need some, though.
Thank you! Here are your cards!
Thank you! Here are your cards!
Thank you! Here are your cards!
Thank you! Here are your cards!

I had a dream, and in that dream there was some place forgotten by everyone...

And strange words came to mind... Here, listen.

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

What does it mean? I don’t know... But apparently there's a long road ahead of you... And there really is no rest for the dead! Anyway, the new ruler is a troubling one...

Give me your hand...
Look, can you see this line? There is a castle looming over a bleak and joyless village. The mysteries that are hidden deep within Darkwater you will discover.
These lines cross - Izbor Yavorsky, the head of the League Defenders, will give you a task himself. A druid and a priest are in dire need of aid.
A mournful wail of an unfortunate soul that is trapped by a force that is powerful and ugly. I fear that this force is going to be looking for you!

I didn't expect to see you so soon, but it's good that you've come. I saw you in my dream last night...
You went to go see our ambassador Klavdius Trojanov, he had a very important task for you. He sent you into a dark place and there were terrible enemies around every corner! Then I woke up in a cold sweat.
Do not go to the dark place alone!

How about you join me for a cup of tea? When you've finished, please give me your cup. Time for reading tea leaves.
Oh, look! Clearly, the leaves show the long and winding road - you will soon take a trip to Eljune to take care of many important matters!
A coin... Careful with Klavdius Trojanov's quest!
There's a shield and a mace... you will be helping Mikhail Selyaninov!
Drink some more. Now there's a tree - the gentle forestfolk will puzzle you with their dilemmas and you will uncover a great secret.
A storm cloud now! A terrible darkness is corrupting the Site of Power.
Drink. The Church of Light is in need of help. You must help them!
The last leaf remains... A monk robe means Zosim Nikulin will need you.
Hurry, dear... to Eljune!

We'll use the cards today. Do you see this? Two of Diamonds - for great struggle. I believe that Coba Plateau is in need of a hero! A grand problem awaits those, who...
Demon Hunters and Historians are in need for aid! In return they will help you.

Look me in the eye, dear, and try not to blink.
Judging by the expression of your eyes, you already know what lies in store for you. And yes, you are right.
I have seen a dragon! There will be a Great Dragon. Go see Izbor Yavorsky again before you leave. Although, perhaps he wouldn't know about the dragon himself...

I don't need the cards this time to tell you what you should do. Go see Aidenus immediately.
I've recently had some very bad premonitions... evil is hovering all around us. I'm sure that Aidenus is aware of it and has a new task to give to you.
The Great Mage will send you to a place unknown, but do trust him. Trust in those who have already fought the evil, the veterans of the Great Astral Campaign!

Perfect timing! Yesterday I had a prophetic dream!
I saw owls, thousands of owls - it's an omen! An omen of something massive! They were heading to Novograd and each of them had a letter in their beak. Inside the letters were weird stones.
Check your mailbox right away. Important news will lead you to the new lands, new adventures, and new secrets.

This is so sad! This mysterious Director who encourages everyone to find the Revelation is drawing more and more attention! People are talking about the secrets of the past, and no one cares about the future anymore! I tried glancing into the future.
Do you know what it holds? Darkness! Impenetrable darkness! I saw nothing!
Director serves his tricks, that's for sure. Maybe I should find this Revelation myself to dispel the darkness!

After the God of Darkness ran away, I recovered my ability to see through the veil of time!
Your future is tough and tricky. I see a coffin! This is a bad omen.Your eyes are empty and your heart is frozen. I see the endless sky reflected in the endless ocean. The sky and the sea are divided with lies and surrounded with deceit spoken by a madman trying to conquer the whole world...
There's a long road, to the stone house and many battles that would change the world forever. That's your destiny!

Show me your palm, darling.

You have a long road ahead of you, through the thicket of the forest, through ice and heat... I can see an awful disease in those far lands, the disease that you will have to fight. A mighty ship in the swirling Astral, two girls, ginger-haired and raven-haired, one laughing, one sobbing. Both are full of pride, but the pride won't do them good. I can see you walking hand in hand with one, fighting the other one, but they both will help you defeat the disaster, however unwilling they will seem to be...

I can see you talking to the ancient Gods, born before the Light, willing to save the world and your own soul from the disaster that is to come! I can also see that their time has gone, and young Gods will arrive, with burning hearts and glowing eyes... These Gods will shape the future and the fate of the world.

This is all I know, and there's nothing else. Go. May your road be straight.

Ah, I don't even need to hold your hand or read tea leaves! I can see everything only by looking at your face.

Soon a madman will ask you for help, and you won't be able to refuse. A new road, long and winding, is waiting for you.

I can see you walking across the land that once used to be thriving. But now there where once was forest, only black stumps are left. I can see plumes of smoke above white-stone fortresses. Fire and death, as far as the eye can see - the wings of war are unfolded above that allod. And you are at the forefront, as always. But don't you lose courage - an army of allies is right behind you!

And your enemy... No. No! It can't be! Again that horror, that blue oblivion with no life or soul! Ah, I can sense a power that's above gods and stronger than the Light... The time itself abides it. And I can't see what lies at the end of the road.

Please, be careful in your ventures. A single wrong move can ruin the whole world!

I'm looking in my divination sphere, and I'm seeing you exploring all of our beautiful Novograd. You will meet an important Elf and a cheerful Gibberling. They will offer very significant jobs...
Now you're clashing with the rebels in northern Lightwood. You will learn many new things. But above all else, I see you embarking on a perilous mission into a fortress captured by the enemy.
Be careful!

Greetings, my friend.

My prediction is really simple this time. Skulnar the Fierce will contact you. I can't tell you the reason.

But there's one thing I do know. You and I will meet again.

I'm leaving Novograd now. I'm going to the Holy Land. I had a bad dream, and my cards have been silent. So I'm thinking about getting a new deck from the Free Traders.

You should find Skulnar the Fierce. As far as I know, he's on Coldberg now.
You are doing important work for Sarnaut! Best suppliers send their wares here to aid your cause.
Fly, little bird! Come back quickly!

Weeell, everything is raaather simple. The hunt starts at 7 pm and 3 am and lasts for four hours. Those who are late, will always be late... We don't wait for anyone. I will give you an Astral Splitter, a Spectral Energy Absorber, a High-Frequency Generator and a Ghost Trap.
You neeeed to find a ghost and beat it up, but don't kill it! As soon as you drain the ghost of its powers, use these devices to weaken it and catch it with our traaaap.
Now pay attention. To catch Shipwright's Ghost, you need to split its en... energy... Split its energy contour first. Draaain it with the Absorber, then use the Traaap and catch it! Use the High-something Generator to catch Cannoneer's Ghost.
To catch Steersmen, you will need Splitter and Generator.
And don't forget the Trap! Remember, this equipment is fraaagile and exp... experim... It hasn't been tested! Sometimes it malfunctions and emits speeectral energyyy. If it haaappens, don't worry and be coool. It is unpleasant, but not deadly.

Stay right there! Thief, I'll kill you!
Wait, you are not one of them! Weeell... I'm sorry. My mistake...
My name is Iron Hoof, the Ghost Hunter. I hunt ghosts, spirits and other evil beings. How may I help?

Mortals can't keep a treasure that falls into their hands. Yes, I found the fragment you've lost. Take it back if you want.
But if you bother me again, I'll bite your head off!

quests: Dull Fragment of the Crystal Armor

t: Astralophone flashes, and a Fragment appears with a note saying: "Be more careful"!
You should talk to Gorislav Gipitsky first.

Who knows?

Although I have a suspicion...

I went to Windswept Foothills once... And suddenly I was stuck, couldn't move a limb. So I think we might find an answer in that place.

The elder is to blame, I tell you! He was the one who got us into this! He was up to something, I just know it. That governor is a filthy traitor, too! Ath-Zak made sure he went to hell. Have we ended up in hell, too? Do we have to put up with this hell forever?
I knew I should have left Gipatia. It would have been better to live in the mountains than sit here and do nothing but send the Chosen Ones to fetch my tools over and over. Look how many of them are here! Most of those Chosen Ones are good for nothing. If I had a copper for every one that I saw, I could have bought a palace by now! Oh well...
What did I live for? Everything's been in vain!

Orcs, I see... Even before you told me, I remembered something - fire everywhere, smoke obscured my vision, and huge shadows danced around as screams filled the air... I thought I caught a glimpse of a nightmare but then I realized that it had been real. It had all been real...
If the dragons keep on pursuing their own goals and don't make adjustments, it seems that we'll have to remain as ghosts until the end of time. It's alright... I suppose we'll get used to it...
Spirit of Order heeds your call...

What? I don't want to talk to anyone... Leave me alone, leave me alone! No, wait... Tell me if the elder or anyone else said anything about me. Do they want to throw me out of the village? No?
Oh, I'd be better off dead! I can't remember anything! Can you hear me? Nothing! I can't recall that fight with Ath-Zak either! Don't you dare forget that! Oh, oh, oh...

So that's how things went... Orcs destroyed the entire village, didn't they? Yes, it was as soon as Ath-Zak left. It's all because I, the militia's commander, was already dead. The barbarians must have grown bolder. They wouldn't have dared to attack the village if I were alive.

Orcs? Those bastards? How could they have caught us unaware? It probably happened after we bid farewell to Ath-Zak, so that he could continue his journey. I drank too much that evening and I can't remember what's happened since then. That's when I must've been killed. How unfair! I can't even remember my last fight...
While Ath-Zak and I were wandering across Gipat we talked a lot, you know. He said something about repressed memories! He had lost his memory then too. Maybe I'll remember everything over time just like he did.
Ah, the Chosen One, the Chosen One!
Ah, the Chosen One, the Chosen One!
Here, I'll cast a spell on you that'll allow you to understand the needs of the portal guardian.
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
Yes, I found it right after you left. Take it and don't lose it anymore. It's not good to throw away such important things!
Oh, if you insist! If you freeze to death, let it be so! Let's get started!

The first thing we've seen here were palm trees in deep snow. Then we spotted June ruins, and boy, were we happy about it! Junes mean treasure!
So we tried and landed here. Ran upon rocks and got stuck. We should have set and gone on the spot, but greed is blind - we landed and dispatched scouts. That's where those scarecrows got on us. I barely escaped, but Nicholas, my companion, was captured and imprisoned.
Can't get him out, can't leave without, so I'm just sitting here freezing off my... back.
Will you be so kind as to find and save him? And look for the treasures, too! I'll pay you back well!
This is the Icy Heart of Ayateotle! Glory to the heroes! We're free!
Can you imagine that? How did they even come up with that idea...

Oh, I knew we should've kept an eye on them. But this! If it weren't for you, , we would've had a tragedy on our hands!

Did you stop Obrad? What happened to that vampire?
Alright, guys! Hold the elf while I show this fool...

Svetlana...?

You must be joking... hiccup? Don't you know Svetlana has been dead for a while?

It happened a long time ago. The old king was still alive, and he had a beautiful daughter. The Valir dynasty ruled from their castle. One day a prince visited us, a noble elf!

We marveled at him, and most of all, Svetlana herself. She fell in love, and it looked like he returned her feelings. They got married here, in the church. But then the prince left for the Ball where all elven families gathered. He was skilled in dark sorcery, and he wanted to prove himself.

He did. But he didn't know a tragedy was about to strike. When he returned to the Castle, his fiancée was lying dead in a coffin. We cried all our eyes out. The prince's face darkened, he locked the doors and started using his forbidden magic. He wanted to bring Svetlana back.

But it didn't work. As soon as the sun was down, a wind rose and blew out all candles in the castle. Screams followed - the dead started breaking out of their graves, eating the servants alive! Everyone fled in terror, trying to get away as far as they could. So did I... though I wish I'd died there.

I'm here now, living out the rest of my life...

Who knows? People are like sheep - they do what they are told. Perhaps one of the nobles said something about Gala and the vamps, and they got spooked.

And who suffers the most? Me! Look what they did to my cart!
I'm a harness maker, and I can do a lot of useful things. Repair armor and equipment, for example.

We fixed a camp not far away from here.
Chubby Family, the astral admirals, are in charge there. How fortunate that they managed to ingrain hope into our hearts and solidate our souls!..
Admirals ordered me to search for the survived and take them to the camp. I'm glad you're alive! It looks like you went through the shipwreck without a scratch, you were born under a lucky star!
Thank you! You saved my life!

Tep's cultists did it! Oh, what in the world blew me to the Frozen Peak!... First the astral pirates riddled my ship, so it finally broke to pieces above that wicked place... We thought it a miracle that we were nearly landing and everybody was safe...
Then those cultists appeared out of nowhere! They pinioned us and dragged us somewhere... My clothes were all torn! I finally found myself in a large crate... That's all that I remember...
Damn it! If only I could gain my strength to break away from here, I'll kill those bastards!
Am I dead? I could not remember... I don't remember anything at all! Oww, it hurts so bad... How could a Spark feel so much pain?

What? You, snot-noses, want to fight me? Ha, ha, ha! You have lost your minds!
Do you really think that you can even scratch me?
Ungrateful mortals... Perhaps it's time to teach you some sense, and to give the next lesson myself!
I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.
I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.

"In the battle of gods that took place in another world, one god was defeated by another. The first one was Sarn, the God of Light. Nihaz, God of Darkness, had to find the way to imprison his enemy, as gods are immortal. He decided to create a new world for the vanquished God of Light..."
These words open Tka-Rik's Revelation. Our world is a prison. Now you have to pass the first trial prepared by Nihaz. Repeat his deed and put Sarn back in chains. To do so, you must use the powers of the Magic Chain five times. Crystal Barrier granted by my armor will help you to resist the God of Light.
Shall we start the first trial? When you're ready, touch these three spheres to obtain special abilities for the forthcoming battle!

Here is the next part of the Tka-Rik's Revelation:
"As long as this world exists, Sarn cannot break loose. Nihaz summoned dragons, the magical beings, to protect Sarnaut. Twelve Dragon Keepers controlled twelve parts of the world. They were the most powerful creatures, their very existence ensured that the prisoner would remain confined.
The planet created by the God of Darkness was barely habitable - only dragons capable of withstanding the extreme cold and heat could live there. They were devoted to their task for millions years, until a huge meteorite collided with Sarnaut. It destroyed a large part of the world, killing three Guardians. Shackles holding Sarn became looser..."
Wait! I feel a hostile presence... There's someone else in here... It can't be a demon, they don't get that far... A cultist?
Will you help me to kill him? Touch the sphere to obtain a special ability to destroy the Crystal Barrier! Hurry up!

I'm sorry, the plan has changed...
My people found a way to return me to life. You are going to playing your part in it, by the way, and so are the Dragons. It's hard to believe - sworn enemies have united to challenge the god!
I will no longer obey the orders of this betrayer who turned my people into the miserable underground beasts! Damn you Nihaz!
I'm going to disappear in a moment. Prepare yourself, as the protective spell that holds the demons will fall. It's an ultimate test for you! Do your best to survive.
Farewell. If it works, we'll never meet again. And remember - don't trust anyone! Neither Sarn, nor Nihaz. Everybody lies, especially gods...
Sorry, but you don't have enough money.
Pay 10 gold to receive the Altruism effect allowing to collect Orbs of Greed safely
Stand still, I'm going to cast a spell that will grant you three attempts...
Here, take this. You won't survive without it.
Let's begin. I would pray for a miracle, but I would not know who to ask. We can only rely on ourselves, I guess.

Truly amazing things you saw! Sarn and Nihaz... No, I never heard these names before. You say, they are the gods who created our world? Never heard of them, I tell thee.

Don’t be upset. Visions are nothing more than just visions. There were no such gods here. No Sarn, no Nihaz, no Tensess, only emptiness, deep black Nothingness looked me in the eye.

The only thing is quite clear: either to start or to stop the Leper can only a god, and nobody else. To tell you the truth, I thought it was Catherina at first, but no, she’s unable to.

Why would gods get angry with us? Why punish? What are our sins?..

Listen on. Catherina turned to believe in the Light. Any belief is not bad, but she found no better thing to do as to suppress old pagan shamans. She put them to prison, executed, punished in all possible and impossible manners. And then the Leper came. Common people grumbled and raged, and suffered a big deal. On the one hand, there was Catherina with her sanctions. On the other hand, there were wicked creatures from the corrupted forest. People chose for the Leper and fled to the woods.

These amulets keep the old gods’ power. Nevermind they are ancient and weak, and unable to fight the Light. Their might is safely stored in the amulets, and if you manage to find them all, I will tell you another story...
We haven’t seen a living soul here for ages!
Thank you! I am so grateful!
Are you out of your mind? You don’t go around losing things like that! Here, make sure not to let it go again.

I thank you with all my heart! Have you come to the old man? I’d rather not go and see him, he’s really short-tempered. Think for yourselves, though. I have to hurry back to the village, see you there. If you stay alive, that is.

What is this? Do you have any idea of what this is? Careful! If you drop it, as much as a hole in the ground will remain instead of the tower!

Elementals? What elementals? Ah, the ones on the roof! They’re easy, just direct the Grain’s power on them, and they’re done.

For the sake of the Astral, go and get the Sphere! And don’t you touch anything else, hear me?
You haven't completed all tasks yet. Talk to me again when you are ready for new adventures.
Well, do you feel better now? Yes, this burden is heavy...

Wait, I'll drink some water. My throat is parched because of your insane stories...
Well... Should I believe you or not? Oh, I feel dizzy... Was it just water I drank?

Hmm... Of course, I have another one. But should I give it to you if you lost the previous one? Do you know what the Standard is? This is an emblem of your troops, do you understand? You have lost the ... this is ... this is unbelievable!
Allright, I'll do you a favor, only thanks to your previous services. Here is your new standard. Make sure not to lose it.

Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
Here you are! May you find the Revelation!... If it actually exists at all, that is.

It's all very simple! You rent a safe deposit box where you can store whatever you want. The cell is not bottomless, you can't fit a lot in there. For a fee you can buy additional deposit boxes to meet your storage needs.

You have so many trophies that your safe deposit box is bursting at the seams? Not a problem! Goblin Banker is ready to provide special deposit boxes with increased capacity in exchange for Expansion Tokens. You can get Expansion Tokens in exchange for all kinds of bags.

Yes, yes, you heard right - a good roomy bag is now a rarity: you can get it as a reward for thoroughly exploring Tep's Pyramid on Irdrich, saving Catherina on the Eclipse, defeating Bedlam at the Winter Palace, surviving the Battle of Gods, and defeating Kyros on the Secret Paths.

An experienced warrior can earn a modest bag on the Battlegrounds, and brave explorers can try their luck in combat with the strongest opponents on the islands in the Astral and at the Observatory on high difficulty.

Great Mage Zayan compared all evidence, obtained on Irdrich and Umoir, and found a trace that led to the key to Tep's secret. He organized an expedition to the distant allod of Ferris, where the source of the Summoner's great power was supposedly located.

Behind the snowy mountains the expedition found something absolutely unexpected - an old Imperial scientific complex from the times of Nezeb. The intrusion awoke the security systems of the laboratories... and not only them. The expedition drew the attention of a mysterious entity, which apparently was the subject of the research. Soon the surveyors found out that the operation of the complex was sabotaged by Tep's cultists.

Deep down the mines of Ferris the expedition came across unknown creatures that called themselves the Architects. Their power was almost divine, and their only aim was to eliminate chaos, which they saw in every living being of Sarnaut. One of them, the Sculptor, granted Tep a grain of his power. Soon afterwards Tep abandoned the complex and recklessly left the Sculptor alive...

Without knowing that, the expedition released the Sculptor from his prison and thus almost let the rest of the Architects break into Sarnaut. Having joined their forces, the heroes valiantly repelled the otherworldly invasion.

But now when our world has caught the attention of the godlike creatures, the League and the Empire are preparing for the worst...

Much of what happened started to make sense when the heroes encountered the mysterious Director. This mysterious manipulator organized a "Play" on the Gipat Shard where he forced everyone to participate in unusual tests. With the help of the Wormfaces, who turned out to be mutated Junes, he was able to show that the June Gates were fake and the Great Astral Campaign was pointless.

Then this Director, who turned out to be the familiar innkeeper from the Holy Land, Gorislav Gipitsky, sent the heroes into the past where they helped save the allod Kirah from destruction during the first attack of the demons.

The true revelation was waiting for the heroes on the next fragment of Gipat - the Isle of Revelation. Here, in the Tka-Rik's cave, the heroes learned that the mysterious Master of the cultists was the former god of Light, Sarn, and the Director Gorislav Gipitsky was the God of Darkness Nihaz.

Nihaz once imprisoned Sarn in Sarnaut. Over time, the God of Light lost his mind and started creating races of destroyers in an attempt to destroy this world and free himself. All existing races are his children, and the last of them are demons.

When his plan failed, Sarn tried to get to the Star Gates, a device that allows travel between worlds, hoping to use it to leave Sarnaut. But he was not alone - the Wormfaces and the Draconids had the same idea. They betrayed Nihaz and tried to get out of the dying world.

Nihaz led his enemies into a trap, and the heroes of Sarnaut helped him with that. But after realizing that the God of Darkness was likely to target them next, the heroes challenged him and seemingly expelled him from Sarnaut.

Skulnar the Fierce, the founder of the school of Orc Psionicists, was disturbed by the visions that visited his students and asked the Heroes of Sarnaut for help. He wanted to find out what awaited them all in the future. The hero turned to all the Psionicists of the world for interpretations, and each of them saw omens of the imminent death of the world.

Elizaveta Rysina received an important prediction. It was revealed to her that the Orcs would revolt and that Skulnar the Fierce would lead them. Rysina tried to attack the Orc Psionicist, but the Hero of Sarnaut did not let her kill him. The Head of the Council promised to watch the Orc carefully after that.

Another prediction was made by Cassandra - one of the Aoidoi' Domini, also a prophetess. She saw the future of the Hero of Sarnaut where he was doomed to die. No matter what the Hero of Sarnaut does, he won't be able to escape it.

These were not the only events that occurred that troubling year: a little later, the hero of Sarnaut and Nihaz made a bet to save the Sparks of the June heroes: Ath-Zak, Lu-a-Jala, and Tka-Rik. And while the Hero of Sarnaut managed to beat the God of Darkness, Klavdia Kalugina took the Sparks.

Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her plan: her target was Nihaz's Citadel hidden behind the Seal. While the heroes and the undead attacked the bastions head-on, Klavdia was able to sneak into the lower levels where she found the coordinates of another world, the world of Klavdia's mother, a powerful deity capable of defeating Nihaz.

To reach her, Klavdia decided to build her own Star Gates – the Gates-3 project was started on Suslanger.

However, a new player intervened: a mysterious saboteur caused the "Incident" which led to the release of large amounts of a new resource - the Ambrosia. This saboteur also stole a key part of the Gates-3 project and disappeared.

Klavdia asked the heroes to resolve the situation - and they managed to learn something. They met a mysterious girl named Alice on Suslanger. Apparently she was behind the "Incident". However, Alice managed to fool everyone for a long time, and no one was able to figure out her true motives.

The result of Alice's activities on Suslanger was the appearance of the Ambrosia which became the new primary energy source coveted both by the League - represented by Catherina - and the Empire. They believed that it came from the world of that same goddess, Klavdia's mother.

Catherina decided to act on her own. The Expedition she assembled went to this world, Eden, where she began harvesting the Ambrosia. But the consequences were different - the race that inhabited this world, the Children, responded to such activities with hostility.

The Hero of Sarnaut arrived in Eden when the conflict was already in full swing. And although they tried to reconcile these warring parties, they did not succeed.

The All-Mother gave the hero several lessons which made it clear that she greatly disapproved of the Gift of Tensess, which was actually the Gift of Nihaz, and of Great Mages' immortality.

In Eden, the Hero of Sarnaut met Klavdia's sister, Hirkalla, who took a different approach, wishing to grant "eternal life" to everyone. She revived the Children from a tribe whose life span had come to an end and set them against the followers of the All-Mother.

The Hero dealt with the followers of Hirkalla, but she herself managed to escape - saying in the end that the Hero needed to decide how to protect Sarnaut.

In the meantime, the conflict between the Children and the Expedition reached boiling point - the Hero had to choose whom to support: the Children protecting their world or the Expedition which acted in the interests of Sarnaut. The war began.

One of the leaders of the Expedition, the Great Mage Felix, wanted to end the war on his own terms with the help of a unique weapon - an Ambrosia mana bomb with incredible destructive power.

While Felix and Catherina were busy building mana bombs, the Children gathered all possible allies. After the decisive battle the All-Mother, wanting to avoid more losses, agreed to go to Sarnaut.

And fell into Nihaz's trap.

Everything that happened was part of his cunning plan. He needed a new prisoner to replace the deceased Sarn, so for years he has been manipulating people from the shadows. Now Nihaz is waiting for the All-Mother to share the power of Creation with him.

To ensure that she remains his prisoner, Nihaz left his daughter, Hirkalla, in his place, entrusting her with the rule of Sarnaut. Hirkalla intends to transform this world according to her vision, vanquishing death completely and definitively.

However, there are those who are willing to challenge her - among them her sister Klavdia who has become Alice, a time traveler trying to change the past for a better future.

Some time after Hirkalla's accession, it became clear that the Great Trees of Sarnaut began to wither. It was caused by the imprisonment of the All-Mother - the divine energies that had emanated from her were cut off. The Gibberlings, led by the seer Unn, tried to contact the goddess through the Trees, and these attempts led them to the half-destroyed allod Howlem, the Pridens' homeland.

They were able to awaken one of the First Ones - the squirrel Ratatoskr. The squirrel told them that their lost homeland Isa still existed, supported by the first of the Great Trees - the Prophetic Ash. And that it can be used to contact the All-Mother.

The heroes of Sarnaut, together with Unn, Murk, Waterlily, and two more Gibberlings - the brothers Wickham and Trondur Sharp - were able to transport themselves to their lost homeland with Ratatoskr's help. There they met the Gibberlings who had survived the cataclysm, but before the heroes could find their forgotten relatives, they ran into the white Urun - the Pridens who had rejected the call of the Voices. These heroes also accidentally destroyed the prison which held the spirit of Kharyskhan, the leader of these Uruns.

The first aborigine they met was a little Gibberling named Gerda who did not have a family. Gerda had an unusual amulet that she inherited from her ancestors. It soon became clear that this amulet was made of meteorite iron - but there were no deposits in this part of Isa. It was a mystery that had no answer yet, but Gerda was determined to learn the truth about her ancestors.

The heroes had to defeat Kharyskhan and unravel the mystery surrounding Gerda and her amulet. The answer was found on a long journey: in the icy mountains they discovered the Freya, one of the ships that had set out in search of Isa. Her captain was Gerda's ancestor. She had the amulet thanks to him. And the Sharps recognized the captain as their distant great-grandfather who had disappeared during the expedition. Thus, it turned out that Sharps and Gerda were very distant relatives.

This captain Koll was able to find Isa thanks to the orc shaman Brus. He promised the shaman he would free the spirit of Skulnar in return - the same Skulnar who once led the Horde in the battle against Kania.

It turned out to be Kharyskhan who had the ability to resurrect in a new body time and again. His goal was to regain his former strength, revive the Horde, and take over the new world. After all, once upon a time he was so powerful that the Orcs' faith in him practically deified his Spark. After the Gray Prince treacherously killed him by order of Nezeb and Tensess, Skulnar's body and his Spark were buried on Isa. After the Cataclysm, the prison was destroyed, and Skulnar's Spark was freed, but it could not leave Isa. Those who imprisoned him tied his Thread of Fate to these lands.

After the Horde fell, Skulnar was gradually being forgotten, and the power of its Spark decreased with each century. Then he decided to create a new cult of himself. Once every few centuries, he accumulated enough power to take over the body of the strongest Priden. He would then spread and strengthen the legend of Kharyskhan among the Urun and Gibberlings. His cruelty helped him remain in the memory of generations and preserve their faith, and therefore his power. And all this time Skulnar kept looking for a way to untie himself from Isa. During his last rebirth, he met the captain of the Freya and learned how it could be done, but his body died before he could accomplish it.

Kharyskhan attacked the Gibberling settlement and managed to capture and kill the Sharps and Gerda. The heroes had no choice but to follow him to the Halls of Fate.

The heroes managed to save Gerda and Sharps by tying their broken Threads of Fate together. Thanks to this ritual, the Thread of Isa itself was now connected to the Threads of the rest of the world. This meant the lost homeland of the Gibberlings was once again open to the world. But in the process, the spell binding Skulnar to Isa was broken. His spark escaped.

The heroes also had to find the Thread of the All-Mother in the Halls and learn how to free her from prison. At the All-Mother's request, a signal was sent to the world of Enod. They hoped it would reach her children, the lords of Light and Order, and they would come and help free her.

Thus hope was born. The Gibberlings found their homeland and were reunited after a thousand years of separation.

The Expeditions of the League and the Empire discovered a new race of Aoidoi which appeared from the Well of Souls after the deaths of Sarn and the Architect. Well of Souls was the concentration of the power of the two dead deities. A terrible explosion gave rise to a separate allod - Ammer. Time there went much faster at first, and a powerful astral storm protected it from outside threats. But when the storm abated, demons started appearing on the allod.

Their victim was Domina Aellona, one of the rulers of the Aoidoi, a member of the Council of Domini. Another Dominus - Kyros who fell in love with Aellona -was immortal. Learning about the possibility of resurrection thanks to the Gift of Tensess, Kyros wanted to resurrect Aellona - but all in vain. Then Kyros decided that universal immortality is a poison that destroys this world, and that it was necessary to destroy Purgatory and the Servant of Tensess.

He managed to get the support of another race from Ammer, the centaurs. Once upon a time, Kyros defeated their leader Citovras in a duel, and now the centaurs respected the warrior of the Aoidoi immensely. The mysterious Wanderer also took his side, revealing the Secret Paths to Kyros. These paths were guarded by a strange creature called Simargl who loved riddles.

Kyros was stopped at the last possible moment, when he was already fighting the Servant. Altered by darkness, the immortal Aoidos vanished.

After these events, the other Dominus handed over power over the Well of Souls to Klavdia, Zayan, and Catherina. They created their own Orders of Followers.

Soon a new Dominus appeared from the Well of Souls - Cosmos. He decided to hold Dionic Games. During the games, Cosmos showed everyone that Nihaz was ready to retaliate. Apparently, Nihaz was behind the Wanderer who helped Kyros.

Cosmos used the Observatory, a unique creation that had its own mind, to send the hero of Sarnaut first to the past, where he saved Skulnar the Fierce, and then to the future, where the hero managed to bring the Sculptor to the present right before the world was destroyed by Nihaz. Later the Sculptor became the chief Architect for all architects in Sarnaut.

Cosmos announced that Nihaz was ready to destroy Sarnaut - and the only chance for the League and Empire to unite, ending all wars. If the leaders of states refused to do this, then Cosmos threatened to erase them from history with the help of the Observatory. That was when the League and Empire signed a peace treaty.

I want to personally reward you for your glorious service. Neither Nihaz, nor the great Astral demons, nor the mutinous Gorluxor, nay, no one but me would ever grant you that which you shall receive! The most precious reward that any mortal could possibly wish for: a vial of dragon's blood, imbued with powerful sorcery.
Having imbibed a vial of this blood, you will attain powers beyond the dreams of most. That, or you will die in agony. But I know you have no fear of danger. So bottoms up, and then we'll talk some more.

The Artifact Converter allows you to exchange artifacts of the same level. The converter consumes Mysterious Particles. Their quantity depend on the artifact level.

I can sell you Mysterious Particles - 10 at a time and no more than 200 particles per week. The initial price of 10 particles is {value}. After every 50 particles the price will increase, but at the start of the next week the price will be back to its original level. Let me know if you want to buy particles. If you have enough money, I will sell them to you.

I can return some of the components spent on creating an artifact or an artifact upgrade scroll you don't want, so you can create another artifact. However, I can't refund gold. But I can return some Fate Elixirs. And, of course, you'll receive your artifact fragments in full!
Then come back when you have the money. Or take an introductory tour - on Aidenus's orders, a token amount is given as a reward at each stage.

Do you want to trade Crystals for gold, or vice versa? I can arrange everything in fine fashion!
Exchange rate is calculated based on the amount of Crystals I currently have. Everything is fare and square - as soon as the rate changes, I'll let you know.
The more Crystals people buy, the higher their price is. And vice versa.
First, choose if you are selling or buying. Enter the required amount, and I will tell you the price in gold.
If exchange rates changed while we were bargaining, I will freeze the deal and tell you the new rate. You will be able to decide if the new rate suits you or not.
I can deliver you from your fear, but it will cost you some drops of mirra. Do you want to proceed?
Go forth and do not be afraid, my child.
I can deliver you from your fear, but it will cost you some drops of mirra. Unfortunately, you don't have enough right now.

You've come to the right place if you want to learn more battle techniques. Novograd is filled with experienced teachers! All of them are under orders right now to train anyone who wants to learn. In times like these the League needs everyone to be at their best!

We have many important citizens right here in Novograd. There are the ambassadors of the Elves and the Gibberlings, as well as the leaders of the Church of Light and the League Defenders.
You can even meet Aidenus himself. Aidenus is the leader of the League, you know. We all owe our lives to his guidance.

Sarnaut is full of new and ancient secrets, but unfortunately we only know a few of them! That's why the League has been working hard to solve as many mysteries as possible. I can tell you everything I know about the knowledge that's already available to the public.
Squabble and Carnage the Roughnecks, two Orc mercenaries who can be found on Coldberg. On behalf of Sigurd the Swindler, we are happy to equip those who have won the trust of the Free Traders.

The Detective Bureau's latest data suggests that the Historians can be found on the remote island of Avilon. If you get there, find Arnaud de Desirae and Firk the Roughneck. The great historian Zayan instructed them to deal with equipment for those who would earn the trust of the Historians.

It's not easy to find the Demon Hunters! They never stay long in one place. But we know from intelligence reports that a small expedition stopped on a recently discovered archipelago called the Dragon Ring. And if you want to earn the trust of the Hunters and get their equipment, find Rustle the Forester, Sofia Lozhkina, and Vasily Gurov in their camp.

The Overlords are a faction of the Wormfaces that live in the Gipat Caverns. Very little is known about them, but now, thanks to the Director, we will be able to communicate with them. It is said that they generously reward anyone who helps them. You will need to contact the master of rewards Lord Krosus and his assistants.

Not so long ago, a mysterious Alice appeared in our world. She claims to have traveled through time, so she knows what happened in the past and will happen in the future. Perhaps she's lying, but who knows? It's hard to know what to believe these days. But if you are wondering what might happen to you in the future if you go on newly unlocked raid adventures, then you need to talk to her.

The mysterious Alice that suddenly appeared in our world is of great interest to the City Council. Alas, our agents have been unable to locate her. But ordinary heroes like you can easily meet her. If you would like an opportunity to look into the future and see what is happening there, you should reach out to her. Of course, it's quite a gamble, but perhaps you will be able to learn more than the Detective Bureau has.

Here's the scoop - there's a bank that just opened in the city.

All citizens are allowed to store things there so we don't have to lug everything around with us. However, it's still partially under construction.

I heard that Aidenus isn't pleased about this, so now the Construction Council is running around like a bunch of chickens with their heads cut off trying to get it all done by the deadline. I sure hope they make it!

In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open world, the brave defenders of the Empire can take part in battles at special training grounds. Here, death means nothing, because everyone is resurrected by the Great Mages. And those who win can receive special rewards. You can learn more from the quartermasters of the respective skirmishes. You can find them in the main square not far from the southern gates. Boyko Sokolov will tell you about the Guild Dominion, Gaal-Bran the Gloomy - about rating combats, and the Roughneck Family - about random skirmishes. In addition, you can also find merchants selling rare goods there, like trophies from the battlefields.

The League Defenders are the best soldiers in the League. They have proven their worth in battle against demons. It is hard to earn their trust - where can you find demons these days?! Only in deep Astral. If you manage that, go to Aidenus' Tower. You will find two knights there: Sergey Orlovsky and Dmitry Devishev. There is also Sofia Kanianskaya. They will offer you valuable goods from their arsenal.

Not so long ago, the Elves were ruled by the House de Desirae. And even now this House has strong ties to the League. It is their representatives, Gregoire and Jules, who are in charge of the elven rewards. They can be found in the Elven Quarter, and the main office of their House is now located on Tenebra.

The Novograd Construction Council manages all of the capital's affairs. At the moment their main focus is completing the construction of Novograd, as you might have guessed. They also attend to the needs of the surrounding area of Lightwood. I urge you to visit them in the Trade District and volunteer your services.

We can't wage wars all the time! Sometimes we need more peaceful activities like swimming on a summer night or jumping over a fire! And there is a more fashionable activity named goblinball. It's an ancient Orc sport, and now anyone can participate. Yes, yes, the League also participates - with Aidenus's approval, they say. There are also championships for those talented enough. You can discuss all that with the sisters Rogneda Whistlie and Barbell the Referie who can be found on the main square near the southern gates.

Mathilde de Grandeur, author of the celebrated book "Medicinal Herbs of Sarnaut", is the local herbalism trainer. She's a bit vain, but she's good at what she does. You can find her in the Elven District.

The Gibberlings have recently made a new home in the colder reaches of Kania. Siveria and Frozen Frontier, to be exact. I hear they're settling down there until they can find their ancient homeland of Isa. Their leader is named Froddy the Fidget, and he's in Frozen Frontier right now. However, his ambassadors can be found in the Gibberling District.

Not the trainer, the trainers! You need to find the Raw Family, to be precise. They're some especially jovial Gibberlings that reside in the Gibberling District. They know all there is to know about leatherworking.

You're looking for Felix de Grandeur in the Elven District. Word on the street is that Aidenus wants to nominate him to be a Great Mage. He's very skilled! I'm sure he can teach you anything you want to know.

Pierre de Desirae represents the interests of the Elves here in Novograd. He speaks for Marguerite de Desirae, the head of the ruling House de Desirae, but she lives on the allod of Tenebra. I hear she has her hands quite full with some important matters, for she hasn't visited Novograd herself in a long time.

A beautiful girlhandsome guy caught your eye? Then what's the problem? Find yourselves a big haystack and have a go at it! But if it's serious, then a priest can marry you. We have one in Novograd, her name is Helena Bugakova. Feel free to ask her. And you won't be committing a sin.
The Gibberling District is where you'll find the Gloomy Family. They know more about mining than anyone else. Hm... gloomy Gibberlings. That's not something you see every day!

The Servants of the Light are beautiful maidens that have devoted their entire lives to the Light! They can be dashing Elven women or noble Kanian girls.
They're everywhere and they're always ready to help travelers by selling drops of mirra. You can visit the Church of Light in the Main Square to find one of these wonderful Servants.

Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical. Progress does not stand still! There is always something new coming out. Ivan Ovsov, an experienced horse breeder, can tell you all about them. He is well versed in technology - he can tell you about assault shells, for example. You can find him in Lightwood, in front of the main gates to Novograd.

So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new kind of equipment - regular quartermasters can't help you anymore. You can get it from Naia Windina who can be found in the Astral Academy next to the forge. It's not the best possible equipment, but it should do for a start. Naia will give you a full set of items, and you can change their stats using special insignias.

Do you think you might make a decent herald? Your skills will not go to waste, because the Free Traders, with Aidenus's permission, have launched a special program to get new heroes to participate in adventures in our world. And you can help them. You can find out the details from the Unselfish Family, representatives of the Tycoons, and you can find them in the bank on the main square of Novograd.

Yaroslav Radiev is who you seek. He's an experienced priest of the Church of Light. His whole life is dedicated to spreading the teachings of Tensess and he will be pleased to speak with you. You can find him in the church in the Main Square!

They say meeting Victor Voronov brings good luck. He saved no less than several dozen Gibberling children during an octulhu's attack on some settlers' ship. He blinded that Astral beast using the light of his faith! You'll find him near the Main Square of Novograd.

Our world holds many secrets. Lovewise Catfish, once a member of the Historians, was invited by Aidenus to come to Novograd and collect information about these secrets.
He searches for knowledge about recent events as well as those from many, many years ago. If you happen to find some important piece of information, head to Aidenus' Tower and tell Lovewise right away.

The ruling Elven House de Desirae is known for studying dark magic. The teacher of this magic, Rene de Desirae, hails from that house. If you're interested in seeing him, you can find him in the Elven District.
Marianne de Ardeur was the first of her people to accept Tensess into her heart. Voisvet Belov used to lead the Church of Light, but after his disappearance this great honor was passed on to her.

Valentina de Ardeur is a famous seamstress. She makes the most beautiful ball gowns you've ever seen! She can teach you everything you need to know about tailoring. Look for her in the Elven District.

In the past, very few allods in Kania had portals, but now we are in a new era of prosperity! Portals have been built all across the land, and we can go anywhere that we need to! You can speak with the Portal Keeper, Hugues de Delice, to ask more about how all of this works. He can be found in Aidenus' Tower.

Reliable armor may save your life one day. Merchants across Kania might offer you a few pieces of equipment, but only in Novograd can you find absolutely everything! I don't even know which direction I should send you off to - just keep your eyes peeled and I'm sure you'll find everything you need!

Time travel? A miracle? No, it's reality. It is quite possible these days - and some mysterious quartermasters have appeared, ready to reward other time travelers! You can find them on one of the Gipat shards known as the Crossroads!

You want a reading? It's not the best time for cards... I had a prophetic dream.

I'll tell you what I saw with my own eyes. I was walking down the street when I saw a red-headed girl. She is gathering young heroes, confusing them with her tales. It's not the right time for heroes to go where she sends them! The heroes are foolish and naive. They don't listen to me.

I saw the faraway lands. Hot lands. The sun is melting the ground, bizarre horses are walking on sand - with humps. I saw strange greenery... And strange cars, and the Orcs driving them...

I also had a vision: someone we both know appeared before the Orcs, and they kneeled before them...

And then a strange storm blotted out the view. I couldn't hear what they talked about because of the roaring sands. I know someone hid something...

And in the end, the metallic glint of blades, and blood splattering across gold... Death! Or did I imagine it? And everything ended well? I can't remember.
What is it that you want?
Excellent, I accept the Emblem and shall report to our leader of your success.
Excellent, I accept the Emblem and shall report to our leader of your success.
Excellent, I accept the Emblems and shall report to our leader of your success.
This scepter can be used to exchange valuables for Emblems of Greatness.
See, how it is completed in a wink! Isn’t it amazing? It is a pity these lodestones only work once a day.
See, how it is completed in a wink! Isn’t it amazing? It is a pity these lodestones only work once a day.
That's one of the greatest constructions! How can I help you?

Have you brought a lodestone? Well, let us see... Here are the trials you can complete.
Thank you. We shall make good use of them. Nothing will be wasted!

t: Fight with Demons? Sure, I'd love that! I'll bring a couple of my buddies along.

O-o-o, Stormer is not only our best fighter. She is our lucky charm and guardian angel. She has saved our squad so many times by slashing through the surrounding enemies, I have lost count! In combat she is not a woman, but a hurricane. And you should keep away from her when she is in action, she could crush you without even noticing it.
But it wasn't so long ago that she joined us. There was this business we were involved in a few years ago. Wild Orcs had gotten into the habit of robbing a village, and we were hired to hang these robbers from the trees along the road. We hunted for that gang for a long time, we combed all the surrounding forests. We finally found the scoundrels and hemmed them into a gorge. Then their leader came out and said: "You will finish us off, but you will lose half of your squad in the process." And she challenged me to a duel. If I won, I could do with them as I wished, if I lost - then they could leave... Anyway, I won that fight. And it turned out that they were not bandits at all, but ordinary Orcs that were forced out of their native village by drought. Anyway, we let these would-be robbers go. But their leader, Stormer, decided to stay with us. And we have nobody more reliable and loyal in our squad than her.
And you should see her fight... It's a wonder to behold! So, if you are after a powerful attack, go ahead and hire Stormer!

If they are unlucky enough to get an elbow in the stomach, then our mercenaries have but one hope - Matron Lighthand. A wonder woman! Her methods are severe, but effective. It goes without saying, if her idea of anesthesia is to give you a whack of a crowbar on your skull!
And you should hear her curse in three languages at the same time! They say that she was thrown out of the Church of Light because of her sharp tongue. But what is that to us? She can curse all she wants, as long as she knows her business. And Stormer can curse up a storm! So, there is no point in going into combat without Matron - she heals wounds, deactivates poison, and removes curses in a flash. And she can flash past your eyes so quickly, you won't know what hit you!

You would have to search to find another soldier like Rowdy Brow. He started as a bouncer in some dirty tavern, then he joined the army, but he didn't stick it for long - he has a difficult character, it is not suited to army discipline. But then he is as strong as a bull, he can break horseshoes with his hands. As soon as this hulk appears on the battlefield and the enemy sees him, they don't pay attention to any other fighters. But it makes no difference to Brow - in heavy armor the blows are like mosquito bites to him. His armor is not simple, it is impregnated with meteorite iron.... if he is not lying, of course.
So, if you need a reliable defender, then you won't go wrong with Brow. True, he is a little touched in the head... He had a difficult childhood, iron toys, a harsh environment. A total redneck, in short, but he earns his contract money, down to the last penny. As he says "no cheating, or the guys won't understand".

Lisa is a little reticent about her past. She has been in our squad for a number of years, but nobody can say that they know her well. She is bitchy and hot-headed, but she is reliable as a rock. I would trust her with my life, no question! But at our first meeting we almost finished each other off!
Because of her quarrelsome nature, she threw in her studies of elf magic, quarreled with her House and left for who knows where. She wandered around the world, gaining experience. She even lived with the druids for a while! And when she got bored with her traveling, she settled in a forest hut next to a small village, and decided to earn a living as a herbalist. Everything would have been fine, but a poor harvest was followed by pestilence. And the peasants were stupid and superstitious. There was this one clever clogs, he remembered about the forest witch and blamed her for all the misfortune. The men armed themselves with sickles and scythes and went to her hut, to burn the witch... But she gave them a good hiding! They ran off so fast, you couldn't see their heels for dust. As soon as they reached their village, they thought hard. They were afraid to go back to the witch themselves. And then we wandered into the tavern. So, the villagers hired our gang to catch the god awful witch and hand over to the local authorities for a fair trial.
Aha, as if she could be caught! She met us on the approach and the whole thing almost ended in a slaughter. Luckily, everything worked out. In the end we had a heart to heart with her, and we agreed that she would leave the village with us, and then we would see. Anyway, it ended up with Lisa staying with our group. And, you know, I have never once regretted that decision. And her ability to meddle with enemies' heads has saved our skins many times!
No problem! Who exactly would you like to return from Purgatory?
Which one would you like to hire? We will help you for free!

How about the Kaboom family? They really know how to handle those cannons!

They are supposed to be on Irdrich, fighting Mechanoids. You should look there for them!

You don't know what a mortar is? Ah, youngsters... Well, it's a Kanian thing, so if you are not from Mother Kania, then it is forgivable. But if you're Kanian, then shame on you!

In short, a mortar is a hollowed out piece of log. What is it for, you ask? To crush things. Grain or hemp - it's what simple peasants do.

And where there are peasants, there are superstitions. And superstitions mean there are witches! Are you catching on?

I don’t know which old hag thought of enchanting a mortar to fly around in, but the witches fell in love with this household item. It's way more comfortable than a broomstick!

Well, as the authorities started taking witches and sorcerers into their service, mortars came into fashion. It's sort of exotic, a real fairy tale!

Another gift from the Dark God who calls himself the Overlord. This item operates on other principles of magic, so it was very difficult to reproduce it in our world. However, the Great Mages unraveled the secret, and the Free Traders immediately started collecting copies.

This is a fast and versatile vehicle. An excellent combat unit. When falling from a great height, it takes no damage. Can swim on or under water, and has many other abilities that weaken enemies.

What is surprising here? Yes, a bear! Have you ever heard the fairy tale about Masha? Masha sat in a box of pies that the bear was carrying, and she was eating pies as they went along. Everything was fine, but then the bear got hungry... Yeah... It didn't end well.

But don't be afraid. Our bears are well-mannered, so they won't hurt you.

But this beast is formidable, and it will be a threat to any enemy.

So it's not surprising that as soon as the Kanians put fighting bears into the line of fire, Xadagan initiated the Red Alert project and started training circus bears.

Bees? Well, bees are quite similar to beetles - they buzz, fly, and they can sting you. And it hurts!

With the advent of the Astral, everything keeps getting bigger. They say that in the distant astral plane there is an archipelago of eight islands - and on one of them everything is gigantic, even things that are not supposed to be this big.

That's why I'm not surprised by riding bees. I hear they use some kind of inner magic to collect honey from flowers around them. If such a bee stops somewhere, small bees will fly to it, believing it to be their queen.

So. The beetle. Yes, it happens. They came here from the southern lands where they crawled around the pyramids and rolled balls of manure, but the local sorcerers came up with the idea of riding them. Made the beetles several times bigger.

They turned out to be decent aeronautical mounts. They fly around, buzzing and causing panic.

When the world split and the Astral appeared, other beetles began to grow, too. Now they're everywhere, so don't be surprised if you see a winged dragonfly elf riding a beetle!

Have you ever seen a broom? Oh, you don't know anything about physical work, do you? You just beat up monsters and break things.

But oh well. A broom is one thing, but flying on it is quite another. Witches came up with it, of course. It's not too tricky - you enchant a stick, then mount it and fly. And what's always at hand? A broom, of course.

However, people are still skeptical about it. Well, only in fairy tales would some guy fly like a bird in the sky. Can you even stay on the broom long enough to take off?

So it's a rare commodity. Only on the Chicken Day, which the clergy call the All Hallows Day, can you buy this curiosity...

The history of Manamobiles is interesting...

It happened in the Empire. Somehow they created an experimental wagon at one of the factories - one that would carry two at a time and could be equipped with a cannon. It's our answer to Catherina's Lightning, they say. But cheaper.

But no matter how hard the Zem engineers and Xadaganians tried, it wouldn't move an inch - didn't even rise from the ground. So they hauled the prototypes off to the scrapyard. Well, the chief engineer is walking home after his shift when he spots a familiar mechanic standing at that scrapyard - an orc named Jack the Deft. The engineer decides to play a joke on him. "The car broke down," he says. "And no one can fix it. Can you do it, Jack? I bet a bottle of vodka that you can't fix it."

The orc scratched his head, and they shook on it.

The next morning, the engineer comes to the scrapyard and sees the car rumbling a yard above the ground. He drops his jaw. And comes closer. For half an hour, he looks at it from all sides, yelling, "How in the world?!" "No way!" But he lost the bet.

They decided to hire Jack, but it turned out that all the unassembled cars had already been sent to Suslanger - to the graveyard for old astral ships in the desert.

But the Orcs are skilled guys - they quickly found a use for them. And by then, the Xadaganian plant had begun producing Manamobiles. Even the Free Traders got the blueprints in exchange for a supply of new engines.

Cats. Have you ever heard that cats are bred by Tekyan monks on the top of the Crystal Mountain?

Well, have you ever been there? Did you see any cats there? Or monks? There you go.

Advertising is the force of progress, or so the Free Traders say. Simply put, you can make money just by embellishing some story. Cats, on the other hand, have the most trivial origins. It's connected to the influence of the Astral. The fact is, after the world split into allods, all the animals on our islands began to grow in size. At first, it became noticeable on Umoir, and they thought the Demon was behind it. But then the same thing happened on Yazes, the Kanian Archipelago, Gipat, Igsh... Everywhere. By our eleventh century, they have grown bigger. It does not affect all of them. For some reason, sentient ones are unaffected, but it happened to every other wild cat out there. Hence the giant cats. We found them on some of the distant islands, decided they were cute, and put them to work. We entrusted this job to one ingenious mage named Yura the Dollmaker.

So he trained the cats, and now they serve as mounts and know all sorts of tricks.

They are just adorable... Even the most vicious Orc Punisher would be charmed.

Oh, what a marvel. Some skald would probably say. But I know a thing or two about history and can responsibly declare that chariots are not a new invention. It was simply forgotten. They were invented by the Aro tribes who were the first to tame horses. It was on the border with the Orcs' steppes. Back when the dragons still existed, the Orcs occupied only a part of those steppes. At the time, the future Kanians used wagons and chariots but didn't ride any animals.

 I'm not surprised this idea was revived on Ammer where they decided to arrange a bull race. After all, horse races already exist; they also ride golems and even fly as Sparks - why shouldn't there be chariots?

So this forgotten idea has become a novelty again. The elves remembered it first..

Lightning Bolt is a unique machine based on the technology developed by the sorceress Catherina. It's one of the world's fastest combat machines that takes no damage from falling from a height and can instantly cover large distances.

Lightning Bolt is now one of the most popular combat mounts. The chassis designed by the Kanian sorceress was later used to create numerous modifications.

Birds? Why not? I've probably said that in recent centuries - all sorts of creatures appeared on allods, and many became popular. Among them are all sorts of winged flyers like crows, jays, parrots.

Everyone wants to stand out these days, so they look for more exotic mounts.

The crows are popular because of witches. They love these birds which suit their gloomy disposition.

The jays are another miracle - a magical bird that flies through the astral plane and brings cold.

And finally, a parrot - this guest from the tropics is the pet of the Aviaks who love bright and colorful things.

Or maybe another bird will appear soon... There are also owls, but it's a different story...

A sled dog? Why not?

As long as it's big enough. And we have plenty of those dogs. There are all kinds of breeds - fighting, shepherd, hounds...

The first dog of this kind came out of an imperial laboratory - sorry, I don’t remember which one. The idea was this - to give the scouts a pet so they could carry their masters and sniff out enemies. So they trained some.

The idea was good. The Kanian intelligence found out and got some dogs for themselves. Now they are everywhere...

Yes, the dragon is a big deal! Dragons are… so impressive!

You probably already know that the world teemed with dragons in ancient times. The most terrible of all were the Great Dragons - Guardian Dragons - but even small things caused a lot of problems.

They killed everyone indiscriminately - the Kanians, the Xadaganians, the Orcs, and the Gibberlings - they killed without mercy, spitting fire and tearing into flesh.

So when the Great Mages came into power, they launched a hunt for the remaining dragons. They paid the hunters that brought them the corpses of these winged creatures. Why do mages need dragon carcasses? No idea! That's their great secret.

So they gradually wiped them out. By the beginning of the Allods era, there were very few dragons left, mostly in remote places. And eventually they just... vanished.

The last Dragon Hunter was a certain Harat. He knew where the last of them were and where they secretly produced offspring. He tracked them down, then sold the eggs to the Free Traders. And those managed to raise the young.

There was one problem - dragons do not grow in captivity. They don't get much bigger than a horse. But even those creatures are still in demand. While there is little magical power in them, they nonetheless have it...

Lions are essentially cats, just with a mane. And with a mane, everyone will look more imposing.

In ancient times, these lions lived somewhere in the steppes... Yes, lions normally don't live in jungles and forests. Remember that.

However, the heroes of our story were lucky enough to fall into the hands of the Elves who fought the Battle for Beauty which in fact was a series of extermination campaigns throughout Yul.

And the Elves appreciated the beauty of lions - they considered them an almost ideal predator. I'd say a tiger or a bear, especially a white one, is more impressive. But, as you understand, the Elves did not ask for my opinion.

They caught a couple of dozen lion cubs and brought them to Irene, a kingdom in the northwestern forests. They started breeding and crossing those cats. That's how riding lions came to be, although it wasn't easy.

So it's believed that the lion is an elven beast, although they are widely sold by the Free Traders now.

Monolith Assault Shell is the latest prototype that allows you to expand your capabilities in battle. This unique mechanism is capable of protecting both the wearer and their allies, making them formidable adversaries! A character wearing an Assault Shell does not take fall damage and has increased movement speed. In addition, the Monolith has several unique abilities of its own!

The Monolith was designed using the blueprints and schematics found on the lost Ferris allod. This allod was a real treasure trove of old inventions of the Empire.

The blueprints for this armor were stolen from the Master's Citadel, otherwise known as Nihaz's Citadel. The heroes infiltrated the structure, connected to the terminals, and decrypted the data which was then sent to the best inventors among the Free Traders. So now the heroes of Sarnaut are armed with the technologies of Nihaz himself.

This shell was created by the Great Mages of the Conclave who used the knowledge found in other worlds. Contains a particle of divine power. The information about other worlds and the subsequent calculations allowed us to learn a lot about the divine energies that exist outside of Sarnaut. Part of these energies are the forces of Destruction, Light, and Death. Nihaz's Citadel contained information on how to accumulate and concentrate divine energies. The Great Mages followed these instructions and created artifacts containing grains of such power, and then created a new armor equipped with them.

A mysterious artifact discovered in the woods of Eden. If you touch it, you can feel the Ambrosia pulsing inside. As it turned out, this armor is filled with the energy of Life itself.

Using the powers acquired in Eden, the engineers were able to create their own magical device that will serve any owner.

These shells are not from our world. Members of the Order of Progress, who delivered supplies to Catherina, got lost on the Star Trail once. They came upon traces of battle and found a few artifacts in various states of preservation. It turned out that these combat mechanisms belonged to the gods of other worlds who fought among themselves. Catherina's apprentices were eventually able to adapt this armor to our needs.

The Vanguard Assault Shell is the pinnacle of engineering. It provides its operator with reliable protection and additional capabilities in battle. This technology was created by Catherina's engineers based on the designs of the Zem people who had achieved significant progress in the field of prosthetics. Using magic reactors similar to those used in Clockwork Knights, the engineers from Glimor created unique "second arms".

Each Vanguard Assault Shell comes with the White Flame costume which includes a headwear, a back piece, and armor. The costume looks great with the Assault Shell. However, the Vanguard Assault Shell and White Flame costume can be equipped separately.

Another creation of Catherina's engineers. Using the blueprints of the Monolith and Vanguard as a base, they tried to combine their strengths. The result is the Escalade shell.

Even more powerful, it grants its wearer additional abilities.

Each Escalade Assault Shell comes with the Cold Synthesis costume which includes a headpiece and overalls. The costume looks great with the Assault Shell. However, the Escalade Assault Shell and Cold Synthesis costume can be equipped separately. In addition, when using the Blaze color pattern, you can also get the Energy Flow costume which is similar to the Cold Synthesis costume.

This mystical armor was created by the Aoidoi who met our world's heroes armed with the latest technology. The Aoidoi were quick to appreciate all that had been achieved in recent times, and after seeing the combat armor, they offered their solution. With the help of Dominus Ionas, they forged new armor and handed it over to the representatives of the League and the Empire.

An attempt by the Kanian engineers to combine combat armor and another variation of the Titan mount. Although the result is very bulky, the combat power of the resulting armor is astonishing. Based on the latest inventions in the field of mana engineering, this armor protects its wearer from any external threat.

Another experiment of the Demonologists. This time, the leaders of the order decided to cross the most powerful demons with their adepts in the form of succubi. The result of this unholy act was the Devourer armor which is essentially a living being that exists in symbiosis with its owner.

Everyone who heard about it probably thought it was a joke.

A riding fish? That flies?

The things the Great Mages come up with...! But yes, that wonder is real.

The Great Mages are what? Immortal! Right. They live long and rarely die. Everything can get boring when you live a long life.

So they come up with all sorts of wonders, bringing fables to life. "Enchanted fish that fly and breathe air?

Ambitious but doable," the wizards probably said, taking out their magic wands.

Therefore, when you see a fish hovering above the ground, don't be surprised. Remember: nothing is impossible!
